description: ONE ticker, any ticker: "how is X trending vs today's move?" on three labelled clocks (today's move, the week to the last close, today so far) plus its SMA 50/150/200 and EMA 9/20 distances. get_momentum does indexes.

include_history.description: Include the plotted [unix_seconds, value] series (close plus all five averages, ~260 points each). Default false — six lines will approach the 10k-token-per-result warning, and the `mas` scalars answer 'where is the line and how far is price from it' without them.

symbol.description: One ticker — the exchange ticker, with a venue suffix for a non-US listing (NVDA, BRK-B, RHM.DE, 9988.HK); FX as the 6-letter pair (EURUSD), indices by short code (SPX). Futures whose code is also a US listing go by their contract root behind a slash, the broker convention — /CL (WTI crude), /HG, /PL, /NG, /RB, /HO; coins by their USD pair (BTCUSD, ETHUSD); the MOVE index as MOVEINDEX; the bare code (WTI, HG, BTC…) means the listing. Required — the payload is a chart's worth of lines, so there is no batch form; call once per name.

window.description: Window the plotted series are sliced to. Default 6mo. Affects ONLY include_history's series — the averages are always full-length and the `mas` scalars are identical on every window.

name: get_stock_moving_averages
